node.statement: Specialization and translation, explicitly using node 1.2.1: take g(h)=V^(-1)(f(x_0+h)-f(x_0)), rather than an arbitrary map satisfying only the secant bound. For any z in B_{(1-c)r}(0), the generic covering construction in nodes 1.2.2.1 and 1.2.2.2 supplies h in B_r(0) with g(h)=z. The defining identity for this particular g is Vg(h)=f(x_0+h)-f(x_0). Hence g(h)=z implies f(x_0+h)-f(x_0)=Vz, and therefore for y=f(x_0)+Vz one has y=f(x_0+h); also x_0+h lies in B_r(x_0). No such translation is asserted for an independently chosen admissible g.
